products.name: SEPS YH-4051
products.description: SEPS YH-4051 is a selectively hydrogenated styrene-butadiene and isoprene copolymer. The source lists medical products, soft rubber toys, glazing compounds, TPE compounding and halogen-free flame-retardant cable coating materials as applications.
products.description_en: SEPS YH-4051 is a selectively hydrogenated styrene-butadiene and isoprene copolymer. The source lists medical products, soft rubber toys, glazing compounds, TPE compounding and halogen-free flame-retardant cable coating materials as applications.

description_i18n.en: SEPS YH-4051 is a selectively hydrogenated styrene-butadiene and isoprene copolymer. The source lists medical products, soft rubber toys, glazing compounds, TPE compounding and halogen-free flame-retardant cable coating materials as applications.
description_i18n.zh: 描述 SEPS 是由丁苯橡胶和异戊橡胶的共聚物经过选择性加氢制得的。与 SEBS 比较，SEPS 橡胶具有更快的油吸收速度、油吸收后较低的表面粘度、较高的硬度和拉伸强度、断裂时较小的永久变形以及良好的附着力，能够附着在各种极性和非极性材料上。 SEBS YH-4051 可用于医疗产品、软橡胶玩具、窗格、TPE造粒、无卤阻燃电缆涂层材料。 规格
